establishment.name: Santini's New York Style Deli - McLean

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the 3 compartment sink is blocked by the storage of plastic food storage trays, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Person in charge removed all items blocking access to hand sink.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken breast (94F) at fryer
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge will discard remaining portion at the end of 4 hours from cooking.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Adequate methods are not being used to control pests. Observed live cockroach on floor of kitchen outside of walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Person in charge contacted pest control technician during inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed pizza dough stored in food storage bags directly on floor of walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Person in charge placed pizza dough in elevated food storage racks.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical quaternary ammonia sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Person in charge ordered test strips during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the dish sink is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed plastic storage containers stored atop sink basin and onions stored in dry storage bin in front of sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed and cleaned all possibility contaminated surfaces.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw shell eggs (72F ambient temperature) stored on cook line; in house garlic and butter spread (55F) stored at ambient temperature at pizza station; sliced provolone (46F) stored on top of cold wells in 2 door prep unit at front service area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge placed items under refrigeration to be cooled to 41F within the remainder of 4 hours.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: sauce cup used to dispense salt and pepper mix
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge removed sauce cup from storage location.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. HAND SOAP DISPENSER AT THE HAND SINK NEXT TO 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WAS OUT OF ORDER.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM ORDERED A NEW HAND SOAP DISPENSER.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: SLICED GODFATHER (44-51F) WAS STORED IN 2-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED ONE LIGHT BULB UNDER THE HOOD BURNED OUT AND ITS GLASS SHIELD IS CRACKED.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM WILL REPLACE THE LIGHT BULB AND ITS SHIELD.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: OBSERVED CARDBOARD LINING UNDER PREP TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS PROMPTED CFM TO REMOVE THE CARDBOARD.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A SPRAY NOZZLE ATTACHED TO HOSE WAS CONNECTED DOWN STREAM FROM AN ATMOSPHERIC VACUUM BREAKER AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. THE PERSON IN CHARGE IS NOT A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER (CFM)
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED WITHIN 30 MINUTES. Santini's New York Style Deli - McLean (Inspection Date: 02/18/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-COMPARTMENT SINK with a concentration of LESS THAN 150 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. SANITIZER DISPENSER IS DEFECTIVE. CFM WILL NEEED TO PREPARE SANITIZER SOLUTION MANUALLY BEFORE THE SANITIZER DISPENSER IS REPAIRED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED GODFATHER (51F), SLICED PROVOLONE CHEESE (50F), TUNA SALAD (48F), AND CHICKEN SALAD (48F) WERE STORED IN 2-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER (FRONT) OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: SLICED GODFATHER (51F) WAS PREPARED ON 2/11/2025, BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN 2-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER (FRONT) FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 2-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER (FRONT) WAS 48F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM DISCARDED ALL FOOD ITEMS THAT HAVE BEEN STORED IN THIS COOLER FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THIS COOLER AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZER DISPENSER AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE SANITIZER DISPENSER AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.
